"''I'll be right there, Captain.|Vaughn and Ahsoka Tano||audio=VaughnFound.flac}} '''Vaughn''', designated '''CT-0292''', was a [[Cloning|clone]] of the [[human]] [[Jango Fett]] who served as a [[Clone Captain]] within the [[332nd Company]], part of a [[332nd Division|division]] of the [[501st Legion]] that was assigned to [[Clone Commander]] [[Rex]] and former [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]] and [[Advisor]] [[Ahsoka Tano]]. As a [[soldier]] in service to the [[Republic Military]] of the [[Galactic Republic]], [[Captain]] Vaughn participated in the [[Siege of Mandalore]] toward the end of the [[Clone Wars]] between the allied forces of the [[Mandalore resistance]] and Galactic Republic and the forces of the former [[Sith apprentice]] [[Maul]]. During the siege, Vaughn led troopers of the [[division]] in the [[capital]] [[city]] of [[Sundari]] and chased Maul's [[Mandalorian super commando]]s into the [[Undercity]]. After being lured into an ambush, Vaughn's [[clone trooper]]s were [[Death|killed]], and Vaughn soon succumbed to the same fate. Ahsoka Tano, who was accompanying the [[trooper]]s, arrived at the scene and witnessed the captain's final moments. Following their death, the Republic and Mandalore resistance ultimately won the siege. ==Biography== {{Quote|Captain Vaughn, what have you got?''"
"''We were cutting off this access point to the Undercity, when we engaged one of the leadership, Gar Saxon.|Ahsoka Tano and Vaughn||audio=VaughnSaxon.flac}} [[File:VaughnTroopsMandalore-OFNF.png|thumb|left|300px|Clone Captain Vaughn led their troops during the Siege of Mandalore.]] Vaughn was a [[Cloning|clone]] of the [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett]] born on the [[planet]] [[Kamino]]. Designated CT-0292, the clone eventually rose to the rank of [[Clone Captain]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic]] and served the [[332nd Company]] within the [[332nd Division]] of the [[501st Legion]] during the [[Clone Wars]]. In [[19 BBY]], they participated in the initial assault of the [[Siege of Mandalore]] when the combined might of both the [[Galactic Republic]] and [[Mandalore resistance]] attacked the [[city]] of [[Sundari]] on the planet{{BuildFalconCite|32|Guide to the Galaxy}} [[Mandalore]], where they hoped to capture former [[Sith apprentice]] [[Maul]]. Vaughn survived the initial landing, where the division took control of the docks, effectively trapping Maul and his supporters inside the city. The [[captain]] and their [[clone trooper]]s would then advance into the city, taking losses but forcing Maul's [[Mandalorian super commando]]s, led by [[Gar Saxon]], to retreat. As the battle progressed to the [[Undercity]], Vaughn spotted Saxon moving into a tunnel and contacted [[Commander]] [[Rex]] and former [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano]], who was officially acting as an [[advisor]] and acting commander to the Republic forces on Mandalore. After they showed Tano where Saxon had retreated, the advisor asked if they led outside the city, to which the captain replied that they did not know. Tano then ordered Vaughn to move in alongside her, and they led a unit of clones to track down Maul's escaping super [[commando]]s. [[File:VaughnDies-OFNF.png|thumb|right|300px|Vaughn dies in Tano's presence.]] Vaughn and their troops cautiously began their advance through the tunnels, but when Maul's supporters attacked them, Vaughn and the [[squad]] chased their attackers further into the Undercity and, in their haste, left Tano behind. Before the advisor could catch up, the squad was separated and methodically picked off, with all [[trooper]]s being eventually [[Death|killed]]. Vaughn was among the last survivors but was critically wounded by a [[blaster]] shot to the chest. When Tano arrived at the scene, she held Vaughn's hand as they said their final words, apologizing to her for their failure. Shortly after Vaughn's death, Maul and his super commandos cornered Tano. Despite Vaughn's death, the Republic and Mandalore resistance ultimately emerged victorious from the Siege of Mandalore.{{TCW|Shattered}} ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|I'm sorry, Commander.|Vaughn, to Ahsoka Tano, shortly before their death||audio=VaughnSorry.flac}} Vaughn was a clone of bounty hunter Jango Fett who stood 1.83 [[meter]]s (6 [[Foot|feet]]) tall, weighed eighty [[kilogram]]s, and had [[Color|tan]] skin. Despite Ahsoka Tano no longer being part of the [[Republic Military]], they still respectfully referred to her as "Commander" and would customize their armor to resemble her facial markings when she returned to their ranks. They proved eager to rush into combat, leading to their demise in the Undercity of Sundari. Feeling that they had failed, Vaughn was apologetic in their last moments, telling Tano that they were sorry for allowing themself and their troops to be ambushed. ==Equipment== At [[Reproduction|birth]], like the other clone troopers, Vaughn was implanted by the [[Kaminoan]] [[scientist]]s with a [[behavioral modification biochip]] to ensure that the trooper would not resist certain [[Executive Order Codes for the Grand Army of the Republic|orders]]. Vaughn wore [[Phase II clone trooper armor]] with the blue markings of the 501st [[Legion]] and a customized [[helmet]] emblazoned with a stylized version of Ahsoka Tano's facial [[tattoo]]s, which also covered their visor. While on Mandalore, they were equipped with a [[DC-15A blaster rifle]] and a [[jetpack]], and their helmet and shoulder armor included integrated [[antenna]]e. They also wielded a [[DC-15A blaster carbine]].{{SideshowCite|set=Sixth Scale Figures|pack=Captain Vaughn|link=collectibles/star-wars-captain-vaughn-hot-toys-909744}} Their helmet included a modified chin extension and dark red lines that were distinguished from the color used for the stylized face of Tano. While searching the Undercity for Saxon and his forces, Vaughn equipped a [[Glowrod|light attachment]] on their helmet. They donned a [[rank insignia plaque]] on their chest armor. ==Behind the scenes== [[File:VaughnConcept.png|thumb|left|325px|Concept art of Vaughn]] Vaughn first appeared in "[[Old Friends Not Forgotten]]," the ninth episode of the [[canon]] animated series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''{{'}} [[The Clone Wars: Season Seven|seventh season]], which first aired on [[April 17]], [[2020]].{{DisneyPlus|subdomain=press|url=disney-plus/star-wars-the-clone-wars/709|text=Episode 709 "Old Friends Not Forgotten"}} The character was first pictured in a promotional poster for the season, posted by the official ''[[Star Wars]]'' Twitter account on [[January 22]], 2020.{{Twitter|starwars|status/1219986891749019648|[[Star Wars]]|quote=The final season of Star Wars: #TheCloneWars starts streaming Feb. 21 on #DisneyPlus.|archivefile=File:SW_TCW_Twitter.png|archivedate=20200209230018}} [[Dee Bradley Baker]] provided Vaughn's voice for the episode, along with all other clone troopers in the series. According to concept art from [[Kilian Plunkett]] created on [[June 25]], [[2018]], their character model was repurposed from that of [[Clone Marshal Commander|Commander]] [[Cody]], who also appeared in the ninth episode. Additionally, Vaughn's name is written as "Vaughan" in the [[The Clone Wars Episode Guides|episode guide's]] concept gallery on [[StarWars.com]]. However, the guide's episode gallery also refers to them by the former name,{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/old-friends-not-forgotten-episode-guide|text="Old Friends Not Forgotten" Episode Guide | The Clone Wars}} and the spelling of their name in the episode's subtitles matches the spelling "Vaughn." Artist [[Marissa Bernstel]] created storyboards for scenes featuring Vaughn while under contract at [[Lucasfilm Animation]], which were then later sent to animators for the animation process.{{WebCite|url=http://www.mbernstel.com/?cat=4|text=Storyboards|author=[[Marissa Bernstel]]|date=2020-03-04|archivedate=20241205035942}} The [[2023]] [[LEGO]] set [[w:c:brickipedia:75359 332nd Ahsoka's Clone Trooper Battle Pack|75359 332nd Ahsoka's Clone Trooper Battle Pack]] erroneously depicts Vaughn without any of the dark red markings on their helmet. Additionally, the rank plaque on their chest is depicted entirely with blue tiles,{{LEGOCite|tcw|75359|332nd Ahsoka's Clone Trooper Battle Pack}} while the plaque in [[canon]] media also has red and gray tiles. ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Vaughn|soundcat=Audio files of Vaughn}} *''[[The Clone Wars: Season 7: Volume 1]]'' {{Co}} *{{TCW|Old Friends Not Forgotten}} {{1st}} *''[[The Clone Wars: Ahsoka vs. Maul]]'' *{{TCW|The Phantom Apprentice}} {{Corpse}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/old-friends-not-forgotten-episode-guide|text="Old Friends Not Forgotten" Episode Guide | The Clone Wars}} *{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/the-phantom-apprentice-episode-guide|text="The Phantom Apprentice" Episode Guide | The Clone Wars}} {{Po}} *{{SideshowCite|set=Sixth Scale Figures|pack=Captain Vaughn|link=collectibles/star-wars-captain-vaughn-hot-toys-909744}} *{{LEGOCite|tcw|75359|332nd Ahsoka's Clone Trooper Battle Pack}} *[[LEGO Star Wars 107|''LEGO Star Wars'' 107]] *{{SWCT|set=For the Republic|cardname=Three|nolink=1}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} ==External links== *{{Twitter|starwars|status/1219986891749019648|[[Star Wars]]|quote=The final season of Star Wars: #TheCloneWars starts streaming Feb. 21 on #DisneyPlus.|archivefile=File:SW_TCW_Twitter.png|archivedate=20200209230018}} {{1stp}} {{Interlang |de=CT-0292 |es=CT-0292 |fr=Vaughn |ja=CT-0292 |ka=ვოუნი |nl=CT-0292 |pl=CT-0292 |tr=Vaughn }} [[Category:Clone trooper captains]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]] [[Category:Officers of the 501st Legion (Galactic Republic)]]
